resources.string: Extra actions for the programmable side key of your phone. Each action is listed separately under “Open the app” in your key settings.
How to use it: open the key settings of your phone (e.g. One Click, Long Press or Double Click), choose “Open the app” and pick one of the actions below.
Smart: app when WLKY is closed
I cannot share your location without access to it
No location found. Is location on?
Opens the camera, ready for a photo.
Sends your current location as a map link through an app of your choice (e.g. WhatsApp).
Calls the number you enter below straight away.
Starts the voice assistant (e.g. Google Assistant).
Does nothing while WLKY is open, otherwise starts the app you pick below. Handy for “long press”, so holding PTT stays just PTT.
